description: Footer block. Green link columns over a giant, bleeding mark.
docs:
CareMetric Footer — Green link columns over a giant, bleeding mark.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep them together in components/blocx/.

Its images are not part of this package. Copy public/blocx/caremetric-footer/ from https://github.com/shadcn-labs/Pin-UI/tree/main/public/blocx/caremetric-footer into your own public/ folder (1 file), or change the paths at the top of the component.
